title: Emrys and the Debt
premise: Emrys Marchetti, a disgraced intelligence analyst, receives an anonymous voiceprint that unlocks a hidden server in Tallinn containing proof of a sanctioned assassination program funded through inherited offshore trusts — including one bearing Emrys's own family name. Hunted by the assassin sent to erase the evidence, and blocked by three governments who each want the truth buried for their own reasons, Emrys assembles an unlikely crew of fellow castoffs to smuggle the archive across a border whose checkpoint shifts change every six hours. The climax forces Emrys to choose between destroying the evidence to save their found family or releasing it at the cost of their own inheritance and safety; in the end, the truth gets out, the assassin defects, and Emrys finally belongs to something worth the price.
about_author: Paloma Halloran is a former border-region translator who spent a decade in Baltic port towns before turning to fiction. She writes thrillers about people the systems forgot, from a farmhouse with unreliable internet.

chapters.title: The Voice in the Static
chapters.summary: Emrys, scraping by on unattributed casework in Lisbon, receives a dead-drop voiceprint that unlocks a remote server. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: wary curiosity — the first spark of purpose since the third agency burned them.

chapters.title: Tallinn, 4 A.M.
chapters.summary: The server opens: financial ledgers tying an assassination program to inherited trusts, one labeled Marchetti. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: cold dread as family legacy curdles into complicity.

chapters.title: Three Flags, One Grave
chapters.summary: Emrys traces the program's cover-up across Estonian, Latvian, and British channels; each government has buried a piece. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: isolation — no institution will take this case.

chapters.title: The Crew Nobody Claims
chapters.summary: Emrys recruits fellow castoffs: Sefa, a smuggler with a grudge; Ilze, a hacked-out signals tech; Tomas, a retired forensic accountant. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: tentative found-family warmth over bad coffee.

chapters.title: What the Trust Bought
chapters.summary: Tomas decodes the trust structure; the inheritance trail runs through Emrys's grandfather's estate. POV: Tomas. Emotional beat: reluctant loyalty — he knows what naming Emrys will cost them.

chapters.title: A Man Called Vessel
chapters.summary: The program's cleaner, an assassin codenamed Vessel, arrives in Lisbon hunting the leak. POV: Vessel. Emotional beat: chilling professionalism masking a crack of doubt about his handlers.

chapters.title: Burn Notice, Homemade
chapters.summary: Vessel finds Emrys's flat; the crew escapes with the archive drive seconds ahead, losing Sefa's boat. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: terror and the fierce realization that the crew matters more than the data.

chapters.title: Riga Rules
chapters.summary: Holed up in Riga, Ilze discovers the archive is incomplete — a key file sits on a server inside the Tallinn embassy district. POV: Ilze. Emotional beat: defiance; she refuses to be a victim again.

chapters.title: The Inheritance Clause
chapters.summary: Emrys learns the trust's final disbursement triggers on their death — they are the program's designated fall heir and intended scapegoat. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Checkpoint Arithmetic
chapters.summary: The crew maps the border checkpoint shift changes; a six-hour window is their only route north with the drive. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: gallows humor bonding the team under pressure.

chapters.title: Diplomatic Baggage
chapters.summary: Tomas walks into the British consulate offering a deal; he's stonewalled, and the meeting is reported to Vessel's handlers. POV: Tomas. Emotional beat: disillusionment — the law he served won't hear the truth.

chapters.title: Vessel's Ledger
chapters.summary: Vessel audits his own kill list and finds his name on a future one; the program burns its instruments. POV: Vessel. Emotional beat: existential vertigo, the hunter realizing he's prey.

chapters.title: Six Hours
chapters.summary: The crew runs the checkpoint window in a refrigerated freight truck; a spot inspection nearly catches the drive. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: white-knuckle solidarity as strangers act like family.

chapters.title: Embassy Rain
chapters.summary: Ilze and Emrys infiltrate the embassy annex for the missing file; Emrys comes face to face with Vessel and, instead of fighting, shows him his name on the list. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: dangerous mercy.

chapters.title: The Defector's Price
chapters.summary: Vessel delivers the annex file but refuses to join the crew, shadowing them instead; three governments now flag the archive as a hostile op. POV: Vessel. Emotional beat: bitter freedom with nowhere to land.

chapters.title: Interpol's Kind Offer
chapters.summary: A British liaison offers Emrys immunity in exchange for the drive and silence; the offer is a trap to bury the case. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: temptation and clarity — justice outside the law or nothing.

chapters.title: Sefa's Debt
chapters.summary: Sefa's old smuggling debt surfaces; his creditor is the trust's fixer, and he's given a choice: betray the crew or die. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: guilt, then the choice to stand by found family over blood money.

chapters.title: The Broadcast Problem
chapters.summary: Releasing the archive safely requires a dead man's press credentials and a satellite window only Ilze can hijack — in six days, during a summit. POV: Ilze. Emotional beat: terrified competence rising to the occasion.

chapters.title: What Grandfather Knew
chapters.summary: Emrys deciphers the original trust letter: their grandfather funded the program under duress and left the archive as a bomb meant for a descendant brave enough to detonate it. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into inheritance of a different kind.

chapters.title: Summit Static
chapters.summary: During the summit, the crew scatters to their stations while Vessel quietly eliminates the fixer's team; the broadcast window opens. POV: rotating brief beats, anchored on Emrys. Emotional beat: held breath before the plunge.

chapters.title: The Debt Called In
chapters.summary: The archive goes public mid-summit; governments scramble, the fixer corners the crew, and Vessel takes the bullet meant for Emrys — surviving, barely. Climax: the truth is out and cannot be recalled. Emotional beat: costly, hard-won vindication.

chapters.title: After the Checkpoint
chapters.summary: Weeks later: inquiries open, the trust is frozen, and the crew — plus a recovering Vessel — regroup in a farmhouse with no attribution and no masters. POV: Emrys. Emotional beat: quiet belonging; the debt paid, the family kept.
